fusions.name: Vice Grip
fusions.desc: Seizes the target and slams it down for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hurled Ingot
fusions.desc: Throws an ingot that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Breastplate Drumming
fusions.desc: Beats your fists on your breastplate, pulling up to 6 enemies within 5 tiles onto you and holding their attention for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow to Anger
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
